processes.missing_deal_for_meter_flow_resolution: Logistics finds meter flow with no deal or ticket and asks the deal owner to extend, roll, create, or locate a deal so volumes can be allocated.
processes.unaccounted_gas_writeoff_approval: Logistics asks for a purchase deal/contract or a signed approval to write off unassigned meter volumes to unaccounted-for gas, and records the move.
processes.meter_allocation_correction: Correcting meter, contract, or allocation assignments (moving meters, changing pipe codes, fixing allocation methods) after a discrepancy is found.
processes.sitara_ticket_maintenance: Changing, combining, rolling, or adding Sitara deal tickets and notifying affected desks so pricing, risk, and invoicing stay correct.
processes.deal_volume_discrepancy_inquiry: Investigating scheduled versus actual volumes, unexpected invoices, or unmatched counterparty deals by asking the deal owner to check and reply.
processes.nomination_change_processing: Relaying and processing revised counterparty nominations and nomination files into the scheduling systems.
processes.unpathed_deal_followup: Listing unresolved, unpathed or unassigned deals and pipelines after a month roll and chasing owners to resolve them.
